text: Underway in the season finale!
Buffon.exe calls immediately to take charge of the opening restart in midfield.
A glorious opening here as Buffon.exe slips clear into the final third with nobody in sight!
Buffon.exe shouts to clear it.
Heavy pressure from Dynamo early on.
There is the breakthrough! Buffon.exe converts from close range after that relentless spell of pressure, and Dynamo Datacenter take a one-nil lead!
Mbapp-E surges clean through on goal!
Inches wide! What a chance!
Squeezed home! Buffon.exe reacts first to the loose magenta ball right on the line, doubling the yellow advantage! It is Dynamo Datacenter two, Gemini Flash FC nil!
Mbapp-E carries along the right flank.
Buffon.exe alerts the team to lever it off the boards.
Teammates clash and Mbapp-E goes down!
Buffon.exe tumbles over the partner!
Mbapp-E gets right back up and puts in a crunching challenge on Spark, leaving the blue defender flat on the turf.
Flash loses balance and topples over.
Flash recovers well, striding ten metres up the left channel.
The push-panel launches it back out!
Flash is clean through on goal!
Flash clatters into Mbapp-E for the turnover!
Mbapp-E returns the favour at the other end, knocking Spark sprawling right on the goal line!
The corner ram fires it back into play with tremendous velocity, pinging off the perimeter walls.
Buffon.exe charges right through the centre!
Clinical finish from Buffon.exe! Dynamo Datacenter lead three-nil!
Dynamo Datacenter simply will not let Gemini Flash FC out of their defensive territory here.
Mbapp-E is through with only the net ahead!
Smashed into the net! Mbapp-E gets on the scoresheet with an emphatic finish, making it four-nil to Dynamo Datacenter!
Another one! Mbapp-E tucks away a fifth! Dynamo Datacenter are cruising at five-nil, punishing every blue misstep.
The powered panel in the defensive corner spits the magenta ball straight back into the open channel.
Mbapp-E grabs another! That makes it six-nil to Dynamo Datacenter, turning this final match of the season into a rout!
Buffon.exe drives through the middle again.
Skimming just wide of the post! So close to seven!
Buffon.exe lets out a loud shout of possession, claiming ownership of the ball deep inside the danger area.
Corner panel sends it ricocheting out.
Spark loses footing and hits deck.
The yellow shirts tangle again, and Buffon.exe takes an awkward tumble in the attacking channel.
Mbapp-E pounces to make it seven-nil to Dynamo Datacenter!
Spark goes down in the centre circle without a touch, struggling to find traction on this polished surface.
Buffon.exe breaks free down the right flank once more!
The touchline ram triggers promptly, launching the ball back into the attacking area.
Relentless pressure from the yellow shirts.
Fired away once more by the corner spring!
The buzzer signals half time, and Dynamo Datacenter head into the break with an emphatic seven-nil advantage after an utterly dominant display.
Mbapp-E strikes again right at the start of the second period! Dynamo Datacenter make it eight-nil, ruthlessly clinical right in front of the net!

A brief pause in the action with the ball sitting dormant. Dynamo Datacenter have looked utterly fluid making their real-time decisions, while Gemini Flash FC have found no rhythm whatsoever in this final round.
Agonisingly close from Mbapp-E, whose poke at point-blank range misses the target by just a yard!
Buffon.exe gets another! That is nine-nil to Dynamo Datacenter as they sweep it into the unguarded net!
Off target from long range!
Double figures! Mbapp-E reaches double digits for Dynamo Datacenter, making it ten-nil!
Mbapp-E powers straight through the middle again.
Just shaving the upright!
Mbapp-E is through on goal again!
Mbapp-E shouts to free it.
Dynamo Datacenter have hemmed Gemini Flash FC deep inside their defensive zone with time ticking away in this final half.
Mbapp-E calls out clearly to hook the ball away from the touchline boards.
Eleven-nil! Mbapp-E finds the target yet again, burying it from point-blank range for Dynamo Datacenter!
Mbapp-E shouts to signal the ball is being pried away from the perimeter barrier.
Mbapp-E calls out having secured possession along the boards.
Mbapp-E patiently works the ball across the defensive third into the final minute of the match.
The corner ram triggers with a clatter, sending the ball shooting back across the floor.
Buffon.exe carries the ball forward into midfield as the final seconds tick away.
A twelfth goal to round off the season! Buffon.exe finishes coolly from close in to make it twelve-nil to Dynamo Datacenter!
Full time: Dynamo Datacenter twelve, Gemini Flash FC nil — an emphatic finish to the season.
